programme.title: Matlock: The Witness Killings (Part 1)
programme.desc: When Matlock returns to his hometown, he ends up defending an accused murderer and becoming the town’s worst enemy.

programme.title: Matlock: The Witness Killings (Part 2)
programme.desc: When Matlock returns to his hometown, he ends up defending an accused murderer and becoming the town’s worst enemy.

programme.title: Matlock: The Strangler
programme.desc: Matlock’s personal accountant seeks representation by Ben when he is framed for the brutal murder of his employer.

programme.title: Matlock: The Nightmare
programme.desc: A vacation to a wild west ghost town becomes more than Matlock bargained for as a bump on the head takes him straight back in time to the real old wild west, surrounded by familiar faces – with very unfamiliar occupations.

programme.title: Matlock: The Marriage Counselor
programme.desc: Matlock’s dull, droning insurance broker, Allan Corning finds therapy for his struggling marriage interrupted by the sudden murder of his therapist, Dr. Harding Fletcher.

programme.desc: When Matlock is slapped by an attractive older woman in a restaurant, Ben recalls to Julie the story of his first case – the murder of the man who put him through law school.

programme.desc: Matlock comes to the aid of a young socialite accused of murdering her older husband for money.

programme.title: Matlock: The Suspect (Part 2)
programme.desc: Matlock comes to the aid of a young socialite accused of murdering her older husband for money.

programme.title: Matlock: The Defense
programme.desc: After witnessing a violent argument between his parents, a distraught young man murders his abusive father.

programme.title: Matlock: The Game Show
programme.desc: Matlock comes to the defense of popular game show host Dennis Blake who’s accused of the murder of his successful, yet despised mega-millionaire producer.

programme.title: Matlock: The Foursome
programme.desc: A brash multimillionaire, Ellis Blake is held in the slaying of Jeffrey Holden, a handsome, young man who intended to marry Ellis’ daughter – without his blessing or consent.

programme.title: Matlock: The Picture (Part 2)
programme.desc: Matlock’s search for evidence to prove his client innocent of killing her husband uncovers a ring of counterfeiters who will pay any price, including murder, to keep their secret. Ben’s investigation uncovers ties to the mob.

programme.title: Matlock: The Outcast (Part 1)

programme.title: Matlock: The Outcast (Part 2)
programme.desc: During his fishing trip, Matlock encounters the small, unfriendly town of Lone Pine as he attempts to solve the mysterious death of a young farmhand and uncover a town-wide coverup.

programme.title: Matlock: The Abduction
programme.desc: While attending a UCLA Law seminar, Matlock and Michelle end up in a dangerous dilemma. After giving Matlock inside information regarding an upcoming hit his former law school classmate is involved in a fatal hit and run.

programme.title: Matlock: Mr. Awesome

programme.desc: When Annie is visited by her old singing teacher, Miss McGowan, Caroline helps Annie pretend to still have her “Cats” role, an act that may have a surprise ending.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: It’s a game of messy politics when Caroline will not endorse a local councilman, who is inspired by her comic strip, while Del conjures up a promotional campaign.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Discreetly planning to ease Caroline’s homesick holiday blues, Richard (Malcolm Gets) goes to great lengths to get a gift for Caroline that inspires suspicion in Julia (Sofia Milos) and sleuthing from Caroline and Annie.
programme.sub-title: Caroline And The Used Car Salesman

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Informed by Annie (Amy Pietz) of Caroline’s (LeaThompson) unspoken love for him, Richard (Malcolm Gets) confronts Caroline, who tells him that it’s a thing of the past.
programme.sub-title: Caroline And The Love That Dare Not Speak Its Name

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: When Caroline (Lea Thompson) is tapped as a celebrity guest star for a quiz show, her jitters prompt Richard (Malcolm Gets) to help her study, much to Julia’s (Sofia Milos) chagrin.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline (Lea Thompson) tries to convince an insecure Del(Eric Lutes) that he has the potential to be a great parent after Del is shocked to discover that he is the father of a 10-year old girl.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: When Julia (Sofia Milos) tells Caroline (Lea Thompson) that it’s not easy being on the outside of her close working relationship with Richard (Malcolm Gets), Caroline quickly, and mysteriously, learns what it’s like to walk a mile in Julia’s shoes.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: As Caroline (Lea Thompson) struggles with commitment issues over Trevor, Richard(Malcolm Gets) inadvertently causes a rift between Caroline and her new beau.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: When Caroline (Lea Thompson) is insulted by a local cabbie, Adamo, she takes her case to higher powers at the travel commission. Meanwhile, Richard, frustrated by a “painter’s block,” becomes obsessed with computers when he joins a cyber cafe.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: When Caroline’s (Lea Thompson)mother, Margaret Duffy (guest star Edie McClurg, “The Hogan Family”), visits Caroline for a mother-daughter People magazine shoot, tensions rise over unexpressed feelings.
programme.sub-title: Caroline And The Visit From The Mom

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline (Lea Thompson) must hire a new cartoon colorist when Richard (Malcolm Gets) finally quits after he and Julia (Sofia Milos) move into their glamorous new home.
programme.sub-title: Caroline and the Marriage Counselor, Pt. 1

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: The fourth-season opener finds Caroline (Lea Thompson) and Richard (Malcolm Gets) savoring their first passionate kiss and preparing for romance.
programme.sub-title: Caroline And The Guys In The Bathroom

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Vengeful father-in-law Mr. Mazzone strips Richard (Malcolm Gets) of all his worldly possessions, forcing Richard to take temporary refuge in Caroline's (Lea Thompson) new office, where he runs afoul of Plum, the no-nonsense office manager.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: After Caroline (Lea Thompson) inadvertently offends office manager Plum (guest star Nancy Lenehan, "Grace Under Fire"), she and Richard (Malcolm Gets) are banished to a damp, dark basement office.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: After Annie (Amy Pietz) loses her boyfriend, her job and her agent, she impulsively accepts a date with her local drycleaner, Gil (guest star Ken Campbell),and spends an evening to remember.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline (Lea Thompson) and Richard (Malcolm Gets) decide to go out on their first official "date" together on Halloween, but their romantic evening turns into fright night when Richard gets himself into a rooftop jam.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline stumbles across Richard's (Malcolm Gets) divorce papers in his desk drawer, but an office mishap sends her on a frantic paper chase to retrieve the documents after they are lost in the interoffice mail.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Tired of losing acting roles to other, more well-endowed women, Annie (Amy Pietz) surprises the gang on Thanksgiving Day by announcing that she plans to get breast implants.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Richard gets an offer that his empty bank account can't refuse: his Aunt Frieda promises to give him $5,000 as a Bar Mitzvah gift if he agrees to finally go through the ceremony.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Richard (Malcolm Gets) agrees to let Reg become a houseguest after the cartoonist has a fight with his girlfriend, Wanda.
programme.sub-title: Caroline And The Big Bad Bed

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline (Lea Thompson) and Del (Eric Lutes) experience mixed results when they become office mentors to a young cartoonist with an overactive libido and an eager marketing student.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline (Lea Thompson) tries to take Charlie (guest star Andy Lauer) under her wing and teach him the fundamentals of life after Del (Eric Lutes) is forced to fire the hapless in-line skater from his job at the greeting card company.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline (Lea Thompson) tries to right an old wrong by giving up a romantic weekend in Boston with Richard (Malcolm Gets) to help out a visiting childhood chum, Joanie (guest star Kelly Coffield), whom Caroline once bullied in school.
programme.sub-title: Caroline And Joanie And The Stick

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline (Lea Thompson) and the gang visit Caroline's family home in Pestigo, Wisconsin, but the homecoming is ruined when her parents tell Caroline that they are selling the house.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline (Lea Thompson) gives Richard(Malcolm Gets) a 7 p.m. deadline to make a marital commitment to her, then is coerced into spending the day making pottery with Del (Eric Lutes) and Annie (Amy Pietz) while she anxiously awaits his decision.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: After deciding they can't wait to get married, Caroline (Lea Thompson) and Richard (Malcolm Gets) plan their nuptials for the following week.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: As Caroline and Richard (Malcolm Gets) prepare to leave for Italy to visit his newborn son, Richard makes a confession that gives Caroline second thoughts about their future together.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline Duffy (Lea Thompson) has her professional life just theway she wants it. "Caroline in the City," the comic strip she created, turned intomerchandising gold with an array of greeting cards, books and calendars.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: To what lengths will boyfriend Arnie go to win over Elaine's kids? Elaine is in for a surprise when she invites him over to meet her children.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The cabbies come to the rescue when Jim tries to convince his family that he didn't squander his inheritance by buying a run-down restaurant.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Latka worries that Simka's wacky behavior might cost her the right to remain permanently in America.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The cabbies embark on a frantic race against time when they team up in a wild nonstop drive from New York to Miami so that Alex can see his long-lost daughter on her twenty-minute layover at the airport in the premiere episode of Taxi.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Alex’s romantic instincts are triggered by the sexy voice at the answering service. Her alluring manner prompts him to arrange a dinner date that turns into a big surprise on Taxi.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: A pretty girl has John in a whirl, and his determination to meet her prompts the taxi gang to come up with a surefire line that would unfreeze any woman on earth in Taxi.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Elaine fears the worst when the cabbies invite themselves to her party for her highbrow art world friends who have no clue that she moonlights as a cab driver.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The high-spirited taxi gang helps a jittery Bobby fight potential disappointment when he decides that he will end his stage career if he doesn’t get an acting job before midnight.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Mechanic Latka Gravas faces deportation unless he marries a U.S. citizen. The taxi gang comes to his rescue by pitching in and hiring a local working girl to be his bride.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: John and his new wife, Suzanne, reach a crisis point in their marriage when one of them must drop out of college due to financial woes.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: A Christmas party at the garage is interrupted when Louie, the dispatcher teams up with Alex in a game of high-stakes poker against his cardshark brother Nick.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The taxi gang scrambles to come up with a scheme aimed at ending a one-sided romance when a determined, pretty cabbie sets her cap for Tony and joins the Sunshine Cab Co. to be near him.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Alex feels sympathy for a fare who’s a real loser with the women and arranges a date for the man with Elaine, who later discovers that her klutzy companion for the evening is a U.S. Congressman.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Bobby’s career dreams come true when he lands a role in a soap opera, prompting him to throw his torn-up cabbie’s license at Louie, but the dispatcher vows to take revenge if Bobby ever comes crawling back.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: After an operation, Louie, the sharp-tongued dispatcher, panics when he has to keep a promise that he made to God during surgery to turn over a new leaf.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Mechanic Latka Gravas’ youthful and attractive mother makes her first visit to America, and after she and Alex meet and have an evening love affair, Latka assumes that he will soon be getting a new daddy.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: When Alex’s ear is nearly shot off in a holdup attempt in his cab, he stuns his fellow cabbies by quitting and exchanging his driving clothes for a waiter’s tuxedo at a snobbish French restaurant.
programme.sub-title: Alex Tastes Death & Finds A Nice Restaurant

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The cabbies fall victim to a Hollywood-style roller coaster ride when a production company visits to do a film on taxi drivers. Life at the Sunshine Cab Company turns into a continual champagne and buffet festivity.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: When John crashes Cab 804, the cabbies are shocked into a period of mourning, as they reminisce about the wild and memorable events that occurred when they were driving the legendary cab.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Mechanic Latka Gravas frantically works to save the cracked-up Cab 804 as the cabbies fondly recall times in the legendary auto when Alex delivered a baby, Louie beat a rich brat out of a wad of money, and Elaine met the perfect man.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: It’s a dream come true for Tony when he’s challenged by an aging ex-champ, but he has more than just a fight on his hand when the opposition unveils its secret weapon.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The cabbies are in for a comedy surprise when the small town kid Bobby befriends, Steve, lands a big role as Romeo the first day he arrives in the Big Apple.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Alex tells Elaine that her hectic schedule of being a mother, a cabbie and a museum employee is driving her crazy and that she should see a psychiatrist. Elaine decides that a quicker cure would be to spend the night with Alex.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Bobby and Tony’s friendship is on the line when they become embroiled in a hilarious love triangle and attempt to outdo each other in vying for the affection of a beautiful young lady.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The overweight blind date Alex once had returned to the scene a svelte shell of her former self, and eager for the romance she yearns for with Alex
programme.sub-title: The Lighter Side Of Angela Matusa

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The riotous race of the century pits Alex against Louie in a winner-take-all bet to see who can bring in the most receipts. Lecherous Louie uses every dirty trick in the book to make sure he wins his prize—an evening with Elaine.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Elaine suddenly starts getting mysterious love letters. When she becomes intrigued by the poetic propositions, a couple of cabbies quickly claim responsibility, leaving Elaine with the hilarious task of discovering who is the amorous writer.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Louie makes a horrible first impression on girlfriend Zena’s parents on Taxi. Louie’s romance with girlfriend Zena takes an outrageous twist when she brings him home to meet her parents.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The cabbies try to make Tony a family man when they convince him to adopt the adorably precocious eight-year-old boy named Brian whom he befriended.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: It’s a hilarious shock to the cabbies when Rev. Jim brings his new pet to the garage—an over-the-hill racehorse that he bought after cashing in on the 300-to-1 long shot. However, he soon finds that it’s impossible to housebreak a horse.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Bobby faces a humorous predicament when it becomes obvious that one of the biggest talent managers in New York is representing him because of his prowess as a lover, and not for his ability as an actor.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: In a protest against unsafe equipment, the cabbies go on strike, and Louie offers an unusual solution to the problem to shop steward Elaine.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: In a hilarious caper, Louie and the cabbies pool all their cash to buy a painting at an auction, planning to cash in big when the artist dies—but when the bidding gets too heavy, the gang turns a dignified auction into a frolicking free-for-all.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Pipe Dream
programme.desc: Ryan's father Ray, a small-time inventor, rolls into town and announces that he's achieved great financial success and is planning to finally marry.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: The Quilt Of Hathor: The Awakening (Part 2)
programme.desc: Jack and Micki return to the religious community to discover that Reverend Josiah, Ryan's future father-in-law, is using it to destroy his enemies in their dreams.
programme.sub-title: The Quilt Of Hathor: The Awakening (Part 2)

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: The Sweetest Sting
programme.desc: A demented beekeeper, McCabe, uses a cursed antique beehive in a complicated scheme. First, he turns loose the bees in the beehive, which kill someone and make a blood-honey.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: The Electrocutioner
programme.desc: An innocent man is condemned to the electric chair but manages to survive. Embittered, the man buys the electric chair from Lewis Vendredi.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: The Prophecies (Part 2)
programme.desc: Micki and Ryan get word of Jack's injury at the end of the preceding episode. They travel to Marie-Mere with Johnny Ventura to investigate and try to recover Lucifer's Bible.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Shadow Boxer
programme.desc: A cursed set of boxing gloves makes their owner unbeatable in the ring...while his shadow goes out and beats an innocent to death.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Maestro
programme.desc: A famous dancer, Anton Pascola, is crippled in an accident before completing his masterpiece, Shiva. He obtains a cursed symphonia (music box).

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: The Shaman's Apprentice
programme.desc: The grandson of an Indian shaman, who has embraced the white man's medicine and become a doctor, is frustrated by the patients he loses. He then comes across a cursed Indian rattle.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Repetition
programme.desc: A newspaper columnist accidentally hits a young girl who was wearing a cursed cameo. The silhouette starts harping at him in the young girl's voice to free her by killing someone else.

programme.title: 7th Heaven
programme.desc: Mary undergoes surgery after getting hit by a car and Annie prays for strength to forgive her father.

programme.title: Secret War: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco
programme.desc: After WWII, SOE disbanded, leaving Vera Atkins to uncover fates of 118 agents, including 13 women. Many were betrayed and sent to camps; some were executed. Atkins' quest continued, marked by personal impact and delayed recognition.
programme.sub-title: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco

programme.title: Battle Of Dunkirk
programme.desc: I et kappløp med tiden krysset over åtte hundre private båter Den engelske kanal for å redde de havarerte soldatene fra infernoet på strendene ved Dunkerque. Se de enkelte veteranenes ekstraordinære heltemot i et slag som endret andre verdenskrigs forløp.

programme.title: Secret War: The Dutch Disaster
programme.desc: Operation North Pole was a WWII German deception using captured SOE agents to mislead Britain. 47 of 50 agents were captured. Despite warnings, SOE ignored signs of compromise to maintain support, leading to a major intelligence failure.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Dutch Collaborator
programme.desc: Anton Adriaan Mussert, initially resisted Hitler’s anti-Semitism despite modeling his NSB party, even welcoming Jewish members. His failed attempt to kidnap Queen Wilhelmina led him into hiding, after which he collaborated in hopes of gaining power.

programme.title: Secret War: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists
programme.desc: Fitzroy Maclean, an MP and WWII spy, supported Tito's Communist partisans in Yugoslavia against the Germans, forging a lasting friendship and honored at Tito's funeral post-war.
programme.sub-title: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Time is Blood 1942-5
programme.desc: Episode 2 begins after the desperate German winter of 1941. Yet 1942 began badly for the Soviets, with more vicious Nazi campaigning seeing millions more Russians captured and starved.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Today’s infantry demands a weapon combining machine gun firepower with rifle accuracy and mobility.. Host Wil Willis traces this journey through iconic firearms.

programme.title: Signs of Evil - The Runes of the SS
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS stands for terror and the murder of millions. Documentary about the history of a symbol that represents murder.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: In Power
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler's secret agenda is to rid Germany of Jews. By 1938, after creating work schemes and rearming, he orchestrates "The Night of Broken Glass," burning 1,000 synagogues and killing 91 Jews, preparing for further aggression.

programme.title: Secret War: Double Agent Tricycle
programme.desc: Dusan Popov was almost certainly James Bond. Ian Fleming knew all the stories about him. Popov managed to persuade both the Germans and MI6 to keep him in the style of a millionaire businessman while performing a series of missions against the Nazis.

programme.title: Secret War: The Scholar and the Fight for Greece
programme.desc: Monty Woodhouse, a professor and a legend for blowing up the Gorgopotamos Bridge in Greece in 1942. In the British counter attack against Rommell at Al Alamein in North Africa it was vital to disrupt German supply routes, Greece.
programme.sub-title: The Scholar and the Fight for Greece

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Lightning War
programme.desc: Country after European country falls before the unstoppable German blitzkrieg.

programme.title: Hitler and I: Reflections on Evil
programme.desc: An in-depth, behind-the-scenes exploration of the making of the miniseries "Hitler: The Rise of Evil."

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: They are iconic weapons: the Tommy Gun, Uzi, and today’s MP5. Invented to break WWI stalemates, the submachine gun revolutionized warfare and culture. Host Wil Willis explores its evolution, firing the Thompson and BAR.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The AK-47, the world's deadliest firearm, sparked a Cold War race for superior assault rifles like the American M4 and German HK 416. Host Wil Willis explores its history, from Mikhail Kalashnikov's WWII experiences to its assembly and lethal impact.

programme.title: Secret War: The Special Interrogation Group
programme.desc: The SIG consisted of German speaking Jewish volunteers from Palestine. They had a highly dangerous job: which was to pose as Germans behind enemy lines and extract intelligence and do acts of sabotage. Few had a long-life expectancy.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 12

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 13

programme.desc: Mark believes that God has turned Jonathan into a dog. Meanwhile, he must contend with a runaway kid and the kid's scatterbrained mother.

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman
programme.desc: Dr. Mike clashes with a traveling faith healer over a cure for Kid Cole’s tuberculosis.

programme.title: Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman

programme.title: Dynasty: Carousel
programme.desc: Dex slår Alexis i kampen om en oljekontrakt. Jeff konfronterer Adam om Kirbys graviditet. Krystle sier ja til Blakes frieri. Del 2

programme.title: Dynasty: The Wedding
programme.desc: Adam frir til Kirby, som har til hensikt å skille seg fra Jeff. Tracy overtaler Krystle til å gi henne selskapets kredittkort og konfidensielle filer. Peter prøver seg på Claudia.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Ring
programme.desc: En fremmed hilser på lille Danny og vet hva han heter. Claudia blir bekymret og flytter familien til herskapshuset. Peter DeVilbis' arkitekt hinter om playboyens rusproblem. Kirbys hånd hovner opp.

programme.title: Dynasty: Lancelot
programme.desc: Kirbys helseproblemer fortsetter. Peter oppfordrer Fallon til å prøve kokain. Tracy saboterer Krystle på kontoret for å vinne Blake over på sin side. Veddeløpshesten Allegre blir stjålet.

programme.title: Dynasty: Seizure
programme.desc: Blake mottar et løsepengekrav for hesten. Peter kunngjør at han skal gifte seg med Fallon. Dex og Alexis blander forretninger med fonøyelser. Kirby får et anfall.

programme.title: Dynasty: A Little Girl
programme.desc: Blake blir mistenksom overfor Peter DeVilbis. Claudia mottar flere fioler fra «Lancelot». Adam forteller Blake sannheten om forgiftningen.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Accident
programme.desc: Allegre leveres tilbake og Blakes mistanker om Peters innblanding forsterkes. Tracy iscenesetter en pressekampanje for å ødelegge Krystle.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Vigil
programme.desc: Peter DeVilbis blir tatt da han forsøker å rømme landet, og blir arrestert for narkotikabesittelse og fengslet. Blake får tilbud om å jobbe i politikken. Fallon gjenvinner bevisstheten og finner ut at hun er lam.

programme.title: Dynasty: Steps
programme.desc: Alexis prøver å bestikke Kirby for å hindre henne i å gifte seg med Adam. Claudia mottar en ny pakke fra sin avdøde ektemann. Fallon kan fortsatt ikke gå, før barnets liv er i fare.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Voice - Part 1
programme.desc: Krystle finner ut at hun er gravid. Fallon lider av smertefull hodepine. Claudia og Steven besøker Matthews ulykkessted i Peru.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Voice - Part 2
programme.desc: Alexis planlegger å forpurre Blakes forretningsavtale med Rashid Ahmed. Tracy prøver å forføre Blake og får sparken. Steven blir mistenksom overfor Dex, som foretar en mystisk oppringning til Claudia.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Voice - Part 3
programme.desc: Dex finner Alexis sammen med Rashid og vender seg til Tracy for trøst. Kirby finner ut årsaken til farens død og kjøper en pistol.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Birthday
programme.desc: Kirby får vite sannheten om farens selvmord. Krystle forteller en forbløffet Alexis om graviditeten. Fallon og Jeff kunngjør at de skal gifte seg på nytt.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Check
programme.desc: Blake reiser til Hongkong for å ordne opp i oljeforretningene i Kinahavet og finner ut at Ahmed har forlatt landet. Mark utpresser Alexis for $100 000, og McVane ser på mens han løser inn sjekken.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Engagement
programme.desc: Alexis forpurrer Blakes lånutsettelse. Sammy Jo ankommer Denver for å treffe sønnen. Mark og Alexis krangler, og Mark blir funnet død etter et fall fra balkongen hennes.

programme.title: Dynasty: New Lady In Town
programme.desc: Blake pantsetter herskapshuset for å skaffe penger. Tracy forteller Alexis om forholdet til Dex. Alexis blir avhørt om Marks dødsfall. Sammy Jo vil ha omsorgen for sønnen sin.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Nightmare
programme.desc: Kirbys forsøk på å drepe Alexis mislykkes, og Alexis lover å holde tett hvis Kirby forlater Adam. Sammy Jo avslører hvem som står bak Claudias mystiske oppringninger.

programme.title: Dynasty: Disappearance
programme.desc: Etter en alvorlig trafikkulykke forsvinner Fallon på mystisk vis. Dex og Steven får Alexis ut av fengsel mot kausjon. Sammy Jo prøver å forføre Adam.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A computer virus attacks a large software company owned by a suspected member of The Marked. Maia visits Promise City and receives an unexpected birthday gift.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Isabelle works with Tom in order to get close to Jordan. Shawn recruits a small band of promicin positives to break Kevin out of Promise City. Tom and Diana face off in the backroom of a grocery store, and Diana is forced to shoot Tom.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Danny Farrell's newfound ability to spread promicin leads to several hundred deaths, including his mother. With Seattle in chaos, NTAC is forced to accept Promise City's offer of help.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A comet is due to pass by Earth, but its trajectory changes to a collision course, causing widespread panic. When the comet appears to slow down - as if it's coming in for a landing - 4,400 people are deposited in an explosion over Highland Beach.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The 4400 returnees have been missing from months to years. None have any memory of where they've been, none have aged, and a small number are beginning to manifest paranormal abilities. Tom Baldwin and Diana Skouris are appointed to investigate.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Carl Morrissey is a lowly supermarket employee who happens to be one of the 4400. He uses his new found powers - enhanced reflexes and strength - to become a vigilante and fight crime in his neighborhood.
programme.sub-title: The New and Improved Carl Morrissey

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana are sent out to investigate a homicide that resembles the MO of a serial killer who was never caught nor heard of for 21 years. The first suspect is Oliver Knox, a member of the 4400.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The 4400 are attacked by a series of bombings after Barbara Yates makes their names and addresses known to the public. Tom, Diana and Dennis try to put an end to the bombings, while at the same time Tom is coping with Kyle's erratic behaviour.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom is furious after finding out that Lytell has taken his son Kyle into custody. Diana offers to help him in getting Kyle back. Meanwhile, Richard suspects that Collier is trying to take control of Lily's life.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: It's been one year since the 4400 returned. After a period of intense medical observation, Tom has returned to NTAC in a limited capacity, assigned only to desk duty. Diana finally finds a way to cut through the red tape and get Tom back.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: It's been one year since the 4400 returned. After a period of intense medical observation, Tom has returned to NTAC in a limited capacity, assigned only to desk duty. Diana finally finds a way to cut through the red tape and get Tom back.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Gary Navarro, a minor league baseball player, finds that he is hearing everyone's unspoken thoughts. His new found ability quickly drives him to the edge of madness.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate Trent Appelbaum, a 4400 whose saliva causes rapid acceleration of a person's metabolism.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A school teacher terrifies parents with her ability to inspire talents within students. Meanwhile, Richard and Lily are confronted by police, and Jordan warns Shawn not to overuse his healing gift.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Maia sees a vision of Jordan Collier's death. Kyle's frightening blackouts are disrupting Tom's personal life. Diana is asked to hand over Maia's diary to NTAC.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: When Tom arrives at NTAC, he learns that no one has ever heard of the 4400. Tom and Diana track down a man to a museum, and during the chase, Tom finds a mysterious lab that only he can see.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate a 4400 who has released a plague that has wiped out an entire town's population. Meanwhile, a Washington D.C. lobbyist joins the 4400 Center in order to add some political muscle to the movement.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate Edwin Mayuya, a 4400 who has the ability is to heal damaged fetal chromosomes while in utero. Unfortunately, it turns out this man is responsible for the slaughter of an entire clinic.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: NTAC follows a series of clues that lead them to Jordan Collier's killer. Tom faces a difficult choice when he must choose between the law or his family.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: 3 months after freeing Santanico from the Titty Twister, the Gecko Brothers are still on the run. Seth & Kate are lost in Mexico while Richie & Santanico plot vengeance on the culebra Lord.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Seth & Kate pull off a heist, while Ranger Freddie Gonzalez confronts visions that lead to a discovery. Back at the Twister, Carlos's emergence from the Labyrinth sets plans into motion.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Richie & Santanico pose as sex traffickers to infiltrate Malvado's food supply. Sonja forces Seth to kick a habit. Freddie faces Sex Machine, who attacks his family to retrieve the codex.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Kate hunts down Scott in Bethel before he can exact revenge. In Houston, Richie & Santanico find themselves in the flesh trade, while Seth tries to get back in Uncle Eddie's good graces.
programme.sub-title: The Best Little Horror House in Texas

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Richie & Seth call a truce & work together to find Malvado's headquarters. Carlos abducts Santanico & claims her for himself. Kate enlists Freddie's help as she attempts to save her brother.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Following the trail of the mass grave, Freddie & Kate uncover an epic secret & find themselves trapped in the cellar of Oculto, one of the more reclusive & dangerous Lords of the Night.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.desc: Big stars and personalities are in Las Vegas to play for hundreds of thousands of dollars and a Hublot watch. Ben Lamb, Kristen Bicknell, and Randall Emmett headline the star-studded lineup at HyperX Esports Arena.

programme.title: Andromeda: D minus noll
programme.desc: Andromedas besättning håller fortfarande på att lära sig att arbeta tillsammans när de attackeras av Återställarna.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dubbel hjelix
programme.desc: Andromeda blir inblandad i en fejd mellan en Than-planet och en nietzscheansk koloni.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ängel mörk, demon ljus
programme.desc: En slipstream skickar Andromeda tillbaka i tiden till strax innan Samväldet faller. Besättningen måste ingripa för att bevara historien.

programme.title: Andromeda: Slipsarna som förblindar
programme.desc: När besättningen svarar på ett nödsamtal hämtar de Bekas bror, som nu är Wayist, och hans vän.

programme.title: Andromeda: Bankerna i Lethe
programme.desc: Ett svart hål gör det möjligt för Dylan att kommunicera med sin före detta fästmö, 300 år tillbaka i tiden.

programme.title: Andromeda: En ros i askan
programme.desc: Dylan är fängslad på en fängelseplanet och måste planera en flykt när hans besättning försöker göra sin egen räddning.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det stora Neptunus hav
programme.desc: Castalianer går ombord på Andromeda för att slutföra stadgan för det Nya Samväldet. När ledaren upptäcks död är Tyr den huvudmisstänkte.

programme.title: Andromeda: Pärlorna som var hans ögon
programme.desc: Beka får reda på att hennes fars tidigare affärspartner säljer en starkt beroendeframkallande drog som kallas Flash.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tårarnas matematik
programme.desc: Andromeda upptäcker sitt systerskepp Pax Magellanic. Besättningen ombord på Pax är 300 år gammal... men har inte åldrats en dag.

programme.title: Andromeda: Musik från en avlägsen trumma
programme.desc: Tyr kraschlandar Eureka Maru på en Nietzscheansk planet och får minnesförlust. Han måste komma ihåg vad han gör innan nietzscheanerna upptäcker honom och hans låda med stöldgods.

programme.title: Andromeda: Harper 2.0
programme.desc: Harper får kunskapens gåva från en döende perseid, men upptäcker att perseiden var eftersökt av en prisjägare som nu har riktat sin uppmärksamhet mot Harper.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tvångsperspektiv
programme.desc: Dylan arresteras för att ha mördat en diktator för 300 år sedan.

programme.title: Andromeda: Summan av dess delar
programme.desc: Andromeda bordas av en drönare från Consensus of Parts, ett mytiskt mekaniskt samhälle. Drönaren är vänlig till en början, men försöker tvinga skeppet att ansluta sig till Consensus.

programme.title: Andromeda: Skräck och avsky i Vintergatan
programme.desc: Gerentex är tillbaka och han kräver att Trance och Harper hjälper honom med sin nya plan: att hitta Tarn-Vedra.

programme.title: Andromeda: Djävulen tar det sista
programme.desc: Dylan och Rev Bem hjälper ett fredligt samhälle att stå upp mot sina slavhandlare, men de måste vara försiktiga: om Dylan lär dem att döda kommer deras barn att födas med vetskap om det.

programme.title: Andromeda: Honungsoffer
programme.desc: Dylan försöker bringa fred mellan två olika Nietzscheanska stolta samhällen genom att eskortera prinsessan i det ena landet till sitt arrangerade bröllop med prinsen i det andra landet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Stjärnkorsad
programme.desc: Rommies avatar blir förälskad i vad som visar sig vara avataren av ett krigsfartyg som heter Gabriel. Gabriel försöker smitta Rommie med ett virus som sänder sina planer till krigsfartyget.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det är ett vackert ljus
programme.desc: Beka tar Andromeda till Tarn-Vedra, men en längre tid i slipstream orsakar biverkningar. För att bekämpa dem börjar Beka ta Flash och blir snart beroende.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dess timme har äntligen kommit
programme.desc: Ett gammalt minne från Andromeda aktiveras av misstag, vilket skickar henne på ett uppdrag och gör att Dylan och besättningen inte kan åsidosätta kommandot.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den växande strömmen
programme.desc: Dylan och Rommie måste rädda Tyr, Harper och Rev från Magogs världsskepp.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Lights Out
programme.desc: In this episode, the decade-old murder of a young Texas housewife is investigated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pet Rock
programme.desc: In 1995, Palm Beach waitress Denise O'Neill is abducted and murdered. Her neighbor Luis Caballero arouses suspicions by behaving oddly towards TV crews covering the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Best Foot Forward
programme.desc: In 2007, Shamaia Smith disappears from a strip club in East Hartford, CT. Police consider various patrons of the club, but focus on local businessman Kenneth Otto.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Disappearance of Helle Crafts
programme.desc: In the series premiere of "Forensic Files", the longest-running true crime series in history, a Connecticut flight attendant goes missing. Police suspect her husband is guilty of murder, but can they prove it?

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Magic Bullet
programme.desc: A fifteen-year-old boy dies from a mysterious gunshot wound to the head while sitting in the lobby of his father's gun club. Ballistics, laser technology, made-to-scale models and the latest in forensic animation are used to find the cause.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The House That Roared
programme.desc: A woman disappears and her husband becomes the prime suspect — especially after police find a huge bloodstain on the carpet of their bedroom. When they spray the bedroom with Luminol, they discover it was awash with blood spatter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Planted Evidence
programme.desc: One morning in a deserted area outside of Phoenix, a motorcyclist discovers the body of a young woman. She had been beaten, bound, strangled and possibly raped. Nearby plants tell investigators more about the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Wilson Murder
programme.desc: On the night of May 22, 1992, Betty Wilson returned home after a meeting and discovered her husband lying in a pool of blood. Jack Wilson had obviously been murdered — but how?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insect Clues
programme.desc: Between 1985 and 1988, 18 people were choked, molested and left for dead in the remote mountains of California. The only witnesses were the insects — and they play an important role in solving the crimes and bringing the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Southside Strangler
programme.desc: Timothy Wilson Spencer was identified as the man who raped and strangled five young women in Virginia. With the use of DNA profiling, an innocent man is freed and the real killer is convicted.

programme.desc: När Lauren bjuder Stephanie på sin födelsedagsfest ifrågasätter Heidi och Spencer Stephanies lojalitet. Spencer sjösätter en plan för att vinna tillbaka Heidi.

programme.title: The Hills: Just Be Careful...
programme.desc: Heidi försöker vinna tillbaka Audrinas vänskap, men Lauren är misstänksam mot motiven bakom. Whitney anpassar sig till sitt nya jobb, men märker snabbt att hon saknar att jobba med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Girls' Night Out
programme.desc: Heidi älskar sitt singelliv ända tills hon ser Spencer med andra tjejer och blir svartsjuk. Whitney värvar Lauren för att hjälpa till på LA Fashion Week, och öppnar på så sätt nya dörrar för Lauren i hennes karriär.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Roommate
programme.desc: Med Spencer ute ur bilden gör Heidi ett sista forsök att återvinna Laurens vänskap. När Audrina börjar umgås mer med Heidi och Justin ifrågasätter Lauren om de ska fortsätta att bo ihop.

programme.title: The Hills: A Date With The Past
programme.desc: En gammal romans väcks upp när Stephen Colletti åter kommer in i Laurens liv. Heidi försöker hindra Stephanie från att gå på Laurens inflyttningsfest.

programme.title: The Hills: No Place Like Home
programme.desc: Lauren kläms mellan vänner när det blir spänt mellan Lo och Audrina. Efter att ha beslutat att det är slut med Spencer accepterar Heidi ett jobberbjudande som kommer att ta henne till Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Hills: The Next Move Is Yours
programme.desc: I säsongsfinalen känner Audrina sig utestängd av Laurens nära vänskap med Lo och funderar på att flytta ut. Lauren gör ett innerligt försök att bli sams med Audrina, men det kan vara för sent.

programme.title: The Hills: We'll Never Be Friends
programme.desc: När säsong fyra börjar är läget mellan Audrina och Lo spänt. Lauren försöker göra gott intryck på en ny kille, och ett besök från Heidis syster Holly hotar Spencers och Heidis förhållande.

programme.title: The Hills: Drama Follows Them
programme.desc: Stephanie blir ovän med sin bror och vän när Lauren springer på Spencer på hennes födelsedag. Kelly Cutrone sparkar nån på People's Revolution och Whitney fyller luckan. Laurens förhållande med Doug kanske går lite för fort fram.

programme.title: The Hills: Better Off As Friends
programme.desc: Lauren inser att personkemin hon hade med Doug i high school inte längre finns kvar. Whitney är nervös över att åka till New York, men en dejt med en snygg modell gör henne gladare. Trots försoningsgesten vill Spencer helt bryta med Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Boys Make Girls Cry
programme.desc: En hejdundrande resa till Las Vegas går snett när Audrina ignorerar Lauren. Brody tar upp Stephanies förflutna, och grabbarna hamnar i finkan. Heidis syster Holly flyttar in, men Spencer vill inget hellre än att sparka ut henne.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Has To Change
programme.desc: Lauren och Audrina kämpar för att rädda sin vänskap, men det kan redan vara för sent. Spencer har fått nog av Heidis syster Holly och tar saken i egna händer. Och Brody och Doug lämnar häktet med nåt nytt att berätta.

programme.title: The Hills: You Always Miss a Best Friend
programme.desc: Heidis syster Holly tar kontakt med Lauren, vilket tvingar både Lauren och Heidi att omvärdera vad som hände med deras vänskap. Audrinas och Justins förhållande sätts på prov när hon jobbar på ett stort event för Epic Records.
programme.sub-title: You Always Miss a Best Friend

programme.title: The Hills: When Lauren's Away...
programme.desc: När Lauren åker på semester med familjen går saker och ting snett i Los Angeles. Stephanie dejtar Doug bakom Laurens rygg, och Audrina och Heidi blir vänner.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Act Innocent
programme.desc: Sanningen om Stephanies förhållande med Laurens ex Doug kommer till slut fram när de alla sammanstrålar på Dougs poolparty. Heidis mamma kommer överraskande på besök till LA och hamnar i en konfrontation med Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: If She Never Met Spencer...
programme.desc: Lauren får ett brev från Heidi där hon ber om ursäkt och inser att det bara finns en sak som hindrar dem från att bli vänner igen. Audrina börjar dejta en ny kille för att göra Justin svartsjuk, men planen slår slint.

programme.title: The Hills: Who To Choose?
programme.desc: Audrina träffar sin gamla flamma Corey igen och bollar plötsligt två killar. Spencer tvingar Heidi att sparka ut sin syster Holly från lägenheten.

programme.title: The Hills: You'll Never Have This
programme.desc: Lauren och Audrina åker till Cabo för Brodys födelsedag, men när Justin blir svartsjuk över Audrinas nya förhållande urartar festen i bråk. Spencer förödmjukar Stephanie när har får veta att hennes nya kille är kompis med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I Want You To Be With Me
programme.desc: Lauren försöker skipa fred mellan Brody och Stephanie. Audrina vill att det ska funka med Corey, men Justin vägrar ge upp. Stephanie undrar om hennes nya kille verkligen är nåt att ha när han bryter sitt löfte att stå på sig inför Brody.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Be With Me

programme.title: The Hills: It's Her Move
programme.desc: Audrina flyttar till ett eget ställe i hopp om att Justin ska flytta ihop med henne, men alla är oroliga att hon flyttar av fel skäl. Heidi bjuder Spencer på ett jobbevenemang och ertappas på bar gärning med att ha lite för kul.

programme.title: The Hills: Back To New York
programme.desc: Whitney reser till New York och förväntar sig att träffa Alex, men får i stället upp ögonen för Jay. Heidi är deppad över att ha fått sparken, men när Spencer går till Brent i ett försök att hjälpa henne få jobbet tillbaka gör han saken etter värre.

programme.title: The Hills: One Last Chance
programme.desc: Lauren låter Heidis syster sova över hos henne. Justin bjuder Audrina på en romantisk helgresa och Heidis frustration över Spencer växer när hon måste böna och be om att få jobbet tillbaka.

programme.title: The Hills: You Did This
programme.desc: Audrina tror på ett rykte hon får höra: Att Lauren har haft ihop det med Justin. Samtidigt försöker Holly hålla Heidi och Spencer åtskilda.

programme.title: The Hills: It's About Trust
programme.desc: Audrina försöker rädda sin vänskap med Lauren efter att ha anklagat henne för att ha haft ihop det med Justin. Spencer och Stephanie besöker sin mormor som är trött på allt deras bråk.

programme.title: The Hills: Dream Boy, Dream Job
programme.desc: Whitney har chansen att få sitt drömjobb i New York och hoppas att träffa Jay där. Lauren blir nostalgisk när hennes föräldrar säljer sitt hus i Laguna Beach. Stephanie vänder sig till Spencer för hjälp när hon inte vet vad hon ska göra med Cameron.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. & Mrs. Pratt
programme.desc: Spencer och Heidi struntar i deras familjers farhågor och flyr till Mexiko för att gifta sig. Whitney satsar på ett drömjobb i New York och tar farväl av Lauren och sitt liv i Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Hills: I Heidi Take Thee Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren och Heidi lägger osämjan åt sidan och minns varför de var vänner. Spencer och Heidi måste ta itu med det hemliga giftermålet när Heidis mamma hälsar på. Audrina får en chock när Justin tar med henne till Palm Springs för en överraskning.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Cry On Your Birthday
programme.desc: När Heidi dyker upp på Laurens födelsedagsfest gråter de båda vännerna över sin förstörda vänskap, och Spencer vill slåss när Cameron anklagar honom för att stöta på en bartender.

programme.title: The Hills: Everything Happens for a Reason
programme.desc: Spencers flörtande får Heidi att åka hem till Colorado där hon träffar en gammal pojkvän. Lauren läxar upp Stephanie för att hon bjöd Heidi på födelsedagsfesten - och Spencer börjar prata med Brody igen.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Heidi kommer på Spencer med bartendern Stacie på en nattklubb och kräver att de ska gå i parterapi. Lauren riskerar sitt goda rykte när hon rekommenderar att People's Revolution ska ta in Stephanie som praktikant.

programme.title: The Hills: Crazy In Love
programme.desc: Audrina försöker kommer över Justin genom att lägga ögonen på Brody. Heidi tvingar med sig Spencer på parterapi och när Stephanie strular till det på People´s Revolution hotar Lauren med att säga upp henne.

programme.title: The Hills: I Always Had A Little Crush
programme.desc: Audrina försöker komma över Justin genom att haka upp med Brody när flickorna krascha pojkarnas surfa resa till Hawaii. Heidis jungfru ex-pojkvän kommer på besök och hon hoppas några av hans värderingar kommer att smitta av sig på Spencer.
programme.sub-title: I Always Had A Little Crush

programme.title: The Hills: Playmates Bring the Drama
programme.desc: Audrinas hjärta krossas när Brodys flickvän konfronterar henne med frågor om Hawaii och Brody gör ingenting för att stoppa henne. Heidi läser ett sms från Stacie till Spencer och drar till en nattklubb för att konfrontera henne.

programme.title: The Hills: Keep Your Enemies Closer
programme.desc: Justin konfronterar Audrina om att hon strulade med Brody på Hawaii. Stephanie förstör en fotografering på jobbet och Lauren ställs till svars inför Kelly. Bartendern Stacie försöker att bli sams med Heidi.

programme.title: The Hills: Father of The Bride
programme.desc: Spencer försöker att rädda förhållandet med Heidi genom att be hennes far om hennes hand. Lauren tvingas att avskeda Stephanie från People's Revolution - vilket riskerar att förstöra deras vänskap.

programme.title: The Hills: Hi Lauren, It's Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren är tveksam om hon ska gå på Heidis bröllop efter det att Spencer äntligen bett om ursäkt. Brody vägrar att riskera vänskapen med Jayde för att rädda förhållandet med Audrina - och Stephanie konfronterar Kelly Cutrone.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Old, Something New
programme.desc: I Laurens sista avsnitt måste hon bestämma sig för om hon kan förlåta Spencer och stötta Heidi på hennes prinsessbröllop. Alla är där - och blir chockerade när en oväntad gäst dyker upp.

programme.title: The Hills: It's On Bitch
programme.desc: Kristin startar krig när hon flörtar med Justin framför näsan på Audrina. Trots att de letar ny bostad tillsammans köper Spencer en utan att Heidi godkänt det.

programme.title: The Hills: Mess With Me, I Mess With You
programme.desc: Efter att Audrina struntat i henne, beslutar sig Kristin för att inte kämpa emot att hon är så attraherad av Justin. Heidi erbjuder sig att sitta barnvakt åt grannen, men Spencer vill inte ha nåt med barn att göra.
programme.sub-title: Mess With Me, I Mess With You

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: The Cherry On The Cake
programme.desc: Anya gillar Kori, men har Kori släppt taget om Sofie? En ny kändis uppmärksammas, originalgänget ställs inför ett tufft val, och en pridefest avslöjar en guldskatt vid regnbågens slut.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Going Going Gone!
programme.desc: Ett nyanlänt ex ser ut att fånga Megans uppmärksamhet. Kris bekänner sina känslor för Ella, Kori och Sofie gör upp, och Nathan ställs inför ett svårt val när en i originalgänget ska ut!

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: The Finale!
programme.desc: Ännu ett ex skakar om två av kändisparen. Hemlighålet släpper sin sista bomb, och den sista måltiden medför en stor överraskning! Frågan är, kommer det att sluta lyckligt eller i tårar?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Journey To Engagement
programme.desc: Sex par och deras före detta måste välja: Fria eller gå skilda vägar? Men innan de säger ja, kan de gå vidare från sina ex?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: You're Breaking My Heart
programme.desc: Paren gör sig hemmastadda i villan, men semestern tar slut när de första exen checkar in. Liam blir förkrossad över sanningen om Leylah och hennes ex. Det första Hemlighålet ger ögonöppnande sanningar och överraskande gäster.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Secrets Of The Past
programme.desc: Hemlighyddan välkomnar fler ex, vilket hotar parens stund i paradiset. Sorinn och Lola har ett explosivt bråk under middagen. Ett nytt ex skapar problem för ett par när en hemlig förlovning uppdagas.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Hitting Rock Bottom
programme.desc: Kamie tar med sig paren ut för att de ska våga ta klivet. Sparis och Shaylas till synes perfekta relation får sig en törn. Ett parti sanning eller konsekvens spårar ur när Jamie är respektlös mot Thailah inför hela villan.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: We Need This Time Apart
programme.desc: Kamie ger ett chockerande besked när paren inleder fas två på väg mot förlovning. Sorinns tvivelaktiga sätt att rädda sitt förhållande med Lola kan få det att ta slut. Leylahs kärlekstriangel gör att hon känner sig respektlöst behandlad.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: I Can Love You Better
programme.desc: Alla partner flyttar ut ur villan, och exen får själva reda ut sina problem. I Hemlighyddan får alla partner en tankeställare om sina ex. Samura sätter igång ett explosivt bråk.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: More Than Just Your Ex
programme.desc: Exen återupplever sina första dejter, och några börjar tvivla på sina nuvarande förhållanden. Leylah försöker vara Liam trogen medan hon umgås med sitt ex Samura.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Burying Your Relationship
programme.desc: Partnerna återvänder till villan och upptäcker vad de andra har gjort. Leylah fattar ett beslut om sitt förhållande med Liam, medan Spari kommer med ett överraskande förslag.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Call Me By My Name
programme.desc: Ett par gör slut efter ett skandalöst avslöjande. Under en intim stund råkar Thailah kalla sin pojkvän vid exets namn.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunited Doesn't Feel So Good
programme.desc: Sparis relation med Shayla prövas när Spari väljer sida i ett villabråk. Ett samtal med Kamie får Thailah att tvivla på sin relation med Jamie.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: This Is What Hearbreak Feels Like
programme.desc: Villan håller andan när ett pars försök att reparera relationen slutar i hjärtesorg. Parens kompatibilitet ifrågasätts på reflektionsceremonin, och vissa par funderar över sin framtid.
programme.sub-title: This Is What Hearbreak Feels Like

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Now Or Never
programme.desc: Paren ska slutligen bestämma om de ska förlova sig eller göra slut. Spari och Shayla pratar ut. Kamie bjuder in några överraskningsgäster för att fira parens slutgiltiga beslut.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Middagsdejt, och så ett ex
programme.desc: Singelkändisarna träffas vid en poolfest & och dyker ner i romantiken. Terrorpaddan berättar om intima middagsdejter, men de får en chock när de får veta att det ska serveras ett ex.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Tagna på sängen
programme.desc: Det är nu eller aldrig för Finn & Paige Kändisarna festar på en strandklubb, där Ashley ifrågasätter sin relation till Jarred, och en överraskningskändis tar Yaz på sängen.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Jag drar
programme.desc: Yaz & Chloe Brockett är öppenhjärtiga, medan Finn och Paige brottas med att bo tillsammans i villan. Ett nytt ex skakar om ett par, och det blir för mycket för en kändis.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Kärleken är en skakig resa
programme.desc: Chloe Veitch & Finn kommer varandra närmare, vilket är jobbigt för Paige. Det knakar i fogarna mellan Yaz & Chloe Brockett, och ett nytt ex blir ett hot för ett av paren.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Lejonexet
programme.desc: Chloe Veitch hamnar i en kärlekstriangel, vänskapen mellan Yaz & Chloe Brockett rasar samman, båtfesten skakas om av ett ex på vattenskoter, och tre kändisar skickas till stranden när nästa ex lurar i mörkret.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Chevy Cavalier
programme.desc: In this episode, the crew pimps Amber's Chevy Cavalier.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Subaru Impreza
programme.desc: In this episode, the crew pimps Louis' Subaru Impreza.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Cadillac Hearse
programme.desc: In this episode, the crew pimps Andrew's Cadillac Fleetwood Hearse.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1988 Daihatsu HiJet
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet från West Coast Customs Wyatts Daihatsu Hi-Jet. Temat är "jet" och de monterar t.o.m. äkta "fasten your seat belt"-skyltar från ett flygplan på bilen.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1978 Cadillac Sedan DeVille
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar gänget Niles Cadillac Sedan DeVille. Nile rullar hem i en pärlemorlackad ceriserosa bil med bagageluckan full av nya skor.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1986 Oldsmobile Cutlass Supreme
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet Logans Oldsmobile Cutlass Supreme. Logan rullar hem med basketgolv och lack i två färger.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1992 Honda Civic
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet Christines Honda Civic. Tre dagar efter att avsnittet med Christine sändes dog en nära släkting i magcancer.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1990 Mitsubishi Mirage
